_comment: Tool definitions reference for assembling the final LLM JSON payload. Apply these changes to the deployed LLM tool definitions when building a new LLM via POST /create-retell-llm.

section_4A_book_calendar_email_descripti.description: Update the email field description in book_calendar's cal_fields array

replace_with.name: email
replace_with.description: attendee email — use jaydiallux@gmail.com as default

section_4B_extract_address_details_varia.description: Append 2 new entries to extract_address_details variables array (address state tool)
section_4B_extract_address_details_varia.name: extract_address_details

append_variables.name: address_house_number
append_variables.description: House number or property name e.g. '14' or 'Rose Cottage'

append_variables.name: address_street
append_variables.description: Street name only e.g. 'Victoria Terrace' or 'Mill Lane'

section_4C_extract_user_details_variable.description: Append 5 new entries to extract_user_details variables array (used in greeter and booking states)
section_4C_extract_user_details_variable.name: extract_user_details

append_variables.name: address_house_number
append_variables.description: House number or name if provided in opening

append_variables.name: address_street
append_variables.description: Street name if provided in opening

append_variables.name: address_postcode
append_variables.description: UK postcode if provided in opening

append_variables.name: address_city
append_variables.description: City or town if provided in opening

append_variables.name: callback_requested
append_variables.description: Set to true when customer rejects all slot offers and callback is offered
